working_definition: Gut cluster defined by antimicrobial peptide expression (Li et al. 2022; Manual Annotation, broad class artefact); an expression-state group with no stated anatomical identity.

best_match.fbbt_definition: A plasmatocyte that can secrete antimicrobial peptides in response to a pathogen (Leitao et al., 2020; Tattikota et al., 2020; Csordas et al., 2021).

justification: FBbt has no antimicrobial-peptide-producing cell term in the gut; the only hit (plasmatocyte) is a hemocyte, unrelated to this gut cluster. No generic fallback is used.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Phagocytic hemocyte. These cells represent about 90% of all hemocytes and secrete antimicrobial peptides and opsonins.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Hemocyte; the cluster is from the gut analysis and the authors do not call it a hemocyte.

recommendation: Curator decision: map to FBbt:00059377 'antimicrobial peptide-producing plasmatocyte' (exact match).
